question: Which of the following teams won the 86th Ranji Trophy title in March 2020? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (30/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: Saurashtra
Baroda
Vidarbha
Mumbai
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Saurashtra

Explanation:
The 86th Ranji Trophy final was played in March 2020 between Saurashtra and Bengal in Rajkot. Bengal scored 411 in the first innings, Saurashtra replied with 274 and took a lead. In the second innings, Saurashtra set a target of 125 runs for Bengal. Bengal were bowled out for 92, giving Saurashtra their first Ranji Trophy title. The team was captained by Jaydev Unadkat. Arpit Vasavada was named Man of the Match for his brilliant performance in the final, scoring 72 runs in the first innings and taking crucial wickets.

question: The duration of the football match in which the extra time is not counted, how much is it? (RPF Constable 2018 (03/02/2019))
options: 30 minutes
60 minutes
3 Hours
90 minutes
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 90 minutes

Explanation:
A standard football match consists of two halves of 45 minutes each, totaling 90 minutes of regular play. This duration excludes extra time, which is added only in knockout matches if the score is tied. Extra time consists of 30 minutes divided into two 15-minute halves. During regular time, the referee may add stoppage time for injuries or delays, but this does not change the core duration. Therefore, without counting extra time, the duration of a football match is 90 minutes.

question: How many styles of wrestling are there in the Olympics? (RPF Constable 2018 (03/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Three
Two
Nine
Four
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Two

Explanation:
The Olympic Games feature two styles of wrestling: Freestyle and Greco-Roman. In freestyle wrestling, athletes are allowed to use their legs to take down and hold opponents, while Greco-Roman wrestling restricts holds to the upper body (arms and torso) only, prohibiting the use of legs. Both styles have men's categories, while women's wrestling is contested only in freestyle. Wrestling has ancient origins in Greece and has been part of the modern Olympics since the 1896 Athens Games. The International Olympic Committee (IOC) considered removing wrestling after the 2020 Olympics, but it was retained. The sport is governed by United World Wrestling (UWW).
